name: Fencing, gates & site walls
notes: Fence and wall unit prices from DOT weighted-average bid prices (FDOT, ArDOT, MDT) plus Fixr consumer guides (low confidence, residential) as bounds. DOT chain-link is right-of-way fencing in long runs (cheap per LF); small DOT quantities (MDT) are outliers. Automatic gates and masonry screen walls are derived.

items.name: Chain-link fence, 6' galvanized, commercial grade (top rail, line posts)

cost.method: FDOT fencing type B 5.1-6.0' $22.55/LF (14 contracts, 36,760 LF, e1); ArDOT 6' steel chain link $38.08/LF and 4'-5' $37.55-$38.18/LF (e2); Fixr 6' residential $15.25-$25.40/LF (e4). MDT small-quantity prices ($152-$200/LF, e3) are outliers. Mid $35 ~ ArDOT 6' less a little for longer private runs; low = FDOT long-run price; high = 8' or vinyl-coated with barbed wire on short runs.

items.notes: Storage yards, utility enclosures, RV/boat storage perimeters, solar farms (solar perimeter often 7-8' with barbed wire).

items.name: Ornamental metal fence, 5-6' steel/aluminum picket (commercial)

cost.method: Fixr: ornamental aluminum material $15-$55/LF plus labor $15-$40/LF (= $30-$95 installed) and wrought iron $25-$75/LF (e6); ArDOT 'steel fence' $52.88/LF (single contract, e2). Commercial-grade galvanized/powder-coated steel picket on concrete-set posts runs above residential aluminum: mid $75; low $45 = residential-grade aluminum; high $130 = heavy commercial/anti-climb steel.

items.notes: Multifamily amenity areas, pool enclosures, storefront/retail frontage. Pool code fences need self-closing gates (add).

items.name: Wood privacy fence, 6' (board-on-board/shadowbox, steel or wood posts)

cost.method: Fixr wood privacy fence $17-$37/LF installed (e5); ArDOT board fence $31.73/LF (single contract, e2). Mid $32 ~ ArDOT and the upper Fixr midpoint; low = Fixr low with long runs; high = board-on-board with steel posts / cedar.

items.notes: Residential subdivision perimeters, BTR communities, buffers adjacent to single-family zones.

items.name: Automatic security gate (20-30' cantilever slide, operator, access control, safety loops)

cost.method: FDOT manual chain-link cantilever gates (gate leaf only) $6,537 for 20-24' and $8,496 for 24-30' openings (e7). An automatic installation adds a commercial slide operator ($4k-$10k), keypad/card reader or call box and intercom ($2k-$8k), safety loops/photo eyes, electrical feed and concrete ($2k-$6k), and usually an ornamental rather than chain-link leaf: $15k-$30k for a single gate; $60k for an entry/exit pair or heavy-duty ornamental gates with full access control.

items.notes: Self-storage, RV/boat storage, gated multifamily. Per gate (one opening).

items.name: Segmental (SRW) retaining wall, geogrid-reinforced, ≤10' (per SF of exposed face)

cost.method: FDOT retaining wall system, permanent (excluding barrier) $49.66/SF on 865,419 SF over 12 contracts (e8) - predominantly MSE panel walls on highway projects. Private segmental block walls with geogrid typically price slightly below DOT MSE: mid $45/SF; low $30 = short (<4') gravity block walls; high $65 = tall walls with extensive geogrid, select backfill and drainage.

items.notes: Measure exposed face area (length x exposed height). Engineering and global stability analysis are soft costs.

items.name: Cast-in-place concrete retaining wall (cantilever, ≤12') (per SF of exposed face)

cost.method: ArDOT retaining wall $68.67/SF (single contract, 19,290 SF, e9). FDOT concrete class IV for retaining walls $1,113.85/CY (e10): a 10' cantilever wall uses ~0.05-0.08 CY of concrete per SF of face (stem + footing) = $56-$89/SF, plus rebar (~$1.52/lb, FDOT), excavation/backfill and drainage ~$15-$30/SF -> $80-$120. Mid $95; low = ArDOT price; high $150 = tall/surcharged walls, architectural finish.

items.notes: Measure exposed face. Loading-dock walls, grade-change walls next to buildings, tight lots where SRW geogrid does not fit.

items.name: Masonry screen wall, 6-8' CMU on continuous footing (stucco or split-face, with cap)

cost.method: Derived (no public unit price captured). 7' average height x $30-$50/SF of wall face for reinforced, grouted CMU with finish on both sides = $210-$350/LF, plus continuous footing ~$40-$80/LF and pilaster/cap allowance -> $250-$500/LF; mid $350.

items.notes: Dumpster enclosures (≈30-40 LF each), sound/screen walls along residential frontages, loading-area screening.
